name: DynamicQuant

x.description: Input tensor to quantize. Supports float16, bfloat16.

smooth_scales.description: Optional tensor, smooth scale factors for per-channel scaling. Same dtype as x. Omit if absent.

scale.description: Scale tensor used for quantization, float32.

description:
DynamicQuant: NPU-accelerated dynamic quantization.

torch_npu.npu_dynamic_quant — performs per-token or per-group dynamic quantization on NPU.

Args:
    x (Tensor): Input tensor to be quantized.
    smooth_scales (Tensor, optional): Smooth scale factors for per-channel scaling.
    group_index (Tensor, optional): Group indices for per-group quantization.
    dst_type (optional): Target data type for quantized output (default int8).

Returns: tuple of (quantized_tensor, scale_tensor).

---
Pure PyTorch equivalent (per-token):
    x_float = x.float()
    if smooth_scales is not None:
        x_float = x_float * smooth_scales.float()
    max_abs = x_float.abs().max(dim=-1, keepdim=True)[0]
    scale = (max_abs / 127.0).clamp(min=1e-10).squeeze(-1)
    quantized = (x_float / scale.unsqueeze(-1)).round().clamp(-128, 127).to(torch.int8)
    return quantized, scale
